patterns.note: The homepage features a dense, non-uniform grid of project thumbnails that fills the entire viewport, acting as the primary navigation and content display.
A minimalist header and footer remain sticky at the top and bottom of the viewport, providing persistent navigation and legal links.
The site's UI elements (text, backgrounds) are strictly monochrome (black and white), allowing the diverse content within project images to introduce color.
The main content area, a dense grid of project snippets, scrolls vertically underneath a sticky header and footer, with no other scroll-triggered animations or reveals.
Project detail pages display a series of images in a flexible layout, followed by a concise text description and project credits.

technique_notes: The homepage is constructed as a full-bleed, responsive grid of project previews, each acting as a clickable thumbnail. This grid scrolls independently while the header and footer remain fixed in place.
Project detail pages present a series of images in a flexible grid or stacked layout, followed by a concise text description and project metadata, maintaining the site's minimalist aesthetic.
The site's primary navigation and utility links are contained within a minimal, fixed header and footer that persist across all pages and scroll depths.

design_tokens.type_scale: Small, consistent sans-serif for body and navigation, with slightly larger but still understated headings on project pages, maintaining a subtle hierarchy.
design_tokens.spacing: Very dense on the homepage grid, balanced and airy for text blocks on interior project pages.

standout: The most distinctive feature is the homepage itself, which foregoes a traditional hero section for an immersive, full-bleed, non-uniform mosaic of black and white project snippets. This creates a highly curated, almost archival feel, immediately showcasing the breadth of work in a visually overwhelming yet engaging manner.
